items.name: Tarnished Watch Badge
items.blurb: Civil Watch, district seventeen. The enamel is chipped and the number's been half-scratched away. It still opens some doors and closes others.

items.name: Waterlogged Notebook
items.blurb: Your own handwriting, except you don't remember writing most of it. The first dry page just says: FIND OUT WHO YOU WERE BEFORE YOU FIND OUT WHO DIED.

items.name: Mutual Ration Card
items.blurb: A punched card from the Drowned Quarter soup line. Whoever owned it was three meals from the bottom.

carryModifiers.reason: It reminds you whose city this is.

items.name: Guild Cargo Chit
items.blurb: A brass token stamped with a crane and a number. The Harbour Guild uses these to log who moved what off the night barges.

items.name: Amber Tincture
items.blurb: Dock-medicine. Cuts the shakes, sharpens the eye, and hollows you out an hour later. Everyone in the Quarter has a bottle they pretend they don't.

items.name: Torn Ledger Page
items.blurb: A single page from a Lantern Syndicate connection ledger. One address in the Drowned Quarter is marked PAID — in a district that's supposed to be dark.

items.name: Brass Lighter
items.blurb: Engraved with initials that aren't yours: 'V.K.' It still sparks. Holding it, your hands seem to know the motion.

carryModifiers.reason: Muscle memory you can't account for.
